name: abi_reset_init
title: ABI: reset is idempotent, clears state and inputs, applies init seeds
description: The SR latch powers on seeded (Q=0, Qn=1). Repeated resets observe the same seeds; after setting the latch and poking S=1, one reset must restore the seeds AND forget the poked input, so the latch stays reset when stepped.
